node.statement: Combining the four local estimates gives m*dist_1(q,C) <= ||m*(q - beta)||_1 <= ||sum_j b_j*(p_j - beta_j)||_1 + ||sum_k c_k*(beta - r_k)||_1 <= sum_j b_j*dist_1(p_j,C) + sum_k c_k*D_k, which is exactly the root inequality; this dependency-linked child is the local replacement for the former appeal to sibling nodes 1.4, 1.5, 1.6.1, and 1.6.2.
